dedupe_keys.name: cy bench benchmark dataset for subnational crop yield forecasting maize and wheat

description: CY-Bench is a dataset and benchmark for forecasting maize and wheat yields at the subnational level where statistics are published. The Zenodo record says it combines yield statistics with growing season weather, remote sensing, evapotranspiration, soil moisture and static soil predictors for 29 wheat and 38 maize countries, curated by agricultural, climate and machine learning researchers of the AgML community, with CSV files per variable category and country plus region centroids and polygons. Version 1.10 was published in October 2025 by authors at Wageningen University & Research, the Technical University of Munich and others under the European Union Public Licence 1.2, free to download, about 6.3 GB. Coverage is major producing countries. Caveats: temporal coverage varies by country, and admin levels differ. For simulation it gives a common test bed to train and compare yield forecast models for food security early warning. Related catalogue records include the JRC MARS AGRI4CAST data and the GEOGLAM Crop Monitor.
